failure: Production recommended a fifth RB, Tony Pollard, while WR3 was empty and all RB/FLEX lineup paths were already occupied.
rootCause: RB/WR construction scoring did not price the marginal-lineup cost of a bench-only player while another flex-eligible exact starter remained empty.
correction: A lineup-derived saturation penalty now applies symmetrically after a position consumes all of its exact and flex paths. Construction ablation removes the penalty, and overwhelming value can still overcome it.
